alt.en: Three simulated tide traces across a dark measurement grid.
alt.zh: 深色测量网格上的三条模拟潮位曲线。

credit.en: Original plotted artwork. Values are synthetic demonstration fixtures.
credit.zh: 原创绘制图像。数值来自演示用模拟记录。

body.en: One day at the waterline, read across three imaginary gauges.
body.zh: 沿着三个虚构测站，读一遍海岸的一天。

notes.en: Explain that the project visualizes a synthetic study.
notes.zh: 说明本项目展示的是模拟观测。

body.en: Each station uses the same interval so a phase shift remains visible across the three traces.
body.zh: 三个测站以相同间隔记录，让曲线之间的相位差清晰可见。

notes.en: Compare sampling cadence and observation length.
notes.zh: 对比采样节奏和观察窗口。

body.en: Follow each line from left to right. Which station reaches its next crest first?
body.zh: 从左向右追踪曲线。哪个测站率先抵达下一个波峰？

notes.en: Invite the audience to trace the curves.
notes.zh: 请观众沿曲线观察变化。
